title: TestMyAgent route row (tma-route/1)
description: One route decision: a use case (the L1 pair type/subtype) goes to an agent, with the verdict that a person cited when they approved it (plan 20261112-tma-c8-routing-from-evals, ADR-1, ADR-2, ADR-4, ADR-5). The field names are the columns of the TMA table eval_routes (task T1); GET /routes/:id (task T2) answers this shape. Identifiers, digests, numbers and short tokens only: every string has a pattern or an enum and a length limit, and there is no free text. target_value and rollback_value are flag values or model cell values; their pattern has no space, newline, quote or backtick, so the apply path (tma route pr) can write them into a .env line or a Markdown cell as they are. The validator in route.js adds the check a schema cannot say: a route in state approved, live, needs_check or rolled_back names its approver and its approval time.

format.description: Optional. A route file may name its shape; the API row may leave it out.

use_case_key.description: The L1 pair type/subtype (Q-T17 = A), for example content/report-html.

route_target.description: env:<FLAG> (one FLAG=value line of a .env file) or claude-md:<row> (the model cell of one row of the CLAUDE.md model table). The flag map dfl-evals routes/targets.json names the file.

rollback_value.description: The value in the file at approval time; the rollback restores it. Null: no old value is known.

agent_sha256.description: The agent the route points to: harness + model + rules + skills (parent ADR-25).

picked_rule.description: The verdict rule the approver picked (Q-T22 = C, ADR-5).

verdict.description: The verdict under the picked rule, frozen at approval (C7): absolute same | close | NOT YET, relative better | same | worse.

n.description: Runs per cell behind the verdict. The API and the apply path refuse n < 5 (C7 ADR-8).

approved_by_actor.description: The human actor who approved the route (an actor id or slug).
